title: Levocabastine ameliorates cyclophosphamide-induced nephrotoxicity in Swiss albino mice via NF-kappaB/cleaved caspase-3/TGF-beta signaling pathways.
authors: Akram, Wasim; Najmi, Abul Kalam; Alam, M Mumtaz; Haque, Syed Ehtaishamul
one_liner_zh: 该文研究左卡巴斯汀对环磷酰胺诱导小鼠肾毒性的保护作用，涉及NF-kB/caspase-3/TGF-beta信号通路，仅含简单分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cyclophosphamide (CP) is a potent anticancer drug, but nephrotoxicity is one of the vital organ toxicities that it causes as a side effect. We tried to evaluate the nephroprotective effect of levocabastine (LEV) in CP-induced nephrotoxicity in Swiss albino mice. Mice were given CP 200 mg/kg, i.p., once on the 7(th) day. LEV (0.05 and 0.1 mg/kg, i.p.) and fenofibrate (FF) (80 mg/kg, p.o.) were given daily for 14 days. On the 15(th) day, animals were sacrificed and kidneys were removed for examination. The docking study showed significant binding of LEV and FF against TGF-beta1, which is a prime target molecule involved in nephrotoxicity. CP 200 group showed nephrotoxicity in terms of oxidative stress, apoptosis, inflammation, and fibrosis as manifested by decreased levels of SOD, catalase, GSH, blood urea nitrogen/creatinine (BUN/Cr) ratio, and increased TBARS, nitrite, TNF-alpha, IL-6, TGF-beta1, IL-1beta, urea, uric acid, creatinine, and BUN. A decrease in body weight (BW) and an increase in kidney weight (KW) with an increased KW/BW ratio was also observed. Cleaved caspase-3 and NF-kappaB expression was also increased. Histopathological aberrations, like renal corpuscle damage, Bowman's space widening, glomerulus, mesangium cell disintegration, atrophic podocytes, vacuolation, and fibrotic changes were also seen. LEV 0.1 and FF 80 significantly reversed these changes toward normal and showed nephroprotective potential. Thus, seeing the protective effect of LEV on CP-intoxicated mice, we conclude that LEV may be used as an adjuvant with CP in cancer, however, it needs more studies with the direct cancer model to confirm the claim.
abstract_zh: 环磷酰胺（CP）是一种强效抗癌药物，但肾毒性是其作为副作用引起的重要器官毒性之一。我们试图评估左卡巴斯汀（LEV）对瑞士白化小鼠中CP诱导的肾毒性的肾脏保护作用。小鼠在第7天一次性腹腔注射CP 200 mg/kg。LEV（0.05和0.1 mg/kg，腹腔注射）和非诺贝特（FF）（80 mg/kg，口服）连续给药14天。第15天，处死动物并取出肾脏进行检查。对接研究显示，LEV和FF与TGF-β1（参与肾毒性的主要靶分子）有显著结合。CP 200组表现出肾毒性，表现为氧化应激、凋亡、炎症和纤维化，具体体现为SOD、过氧化氢酶、GSH、血尿素氮/肌酐（BUN/Cr）比值降低，以及TBARS、亚硝酸盐、TNF-α、IL-6、TGF-β1、IL-1β、尿素、尿酸、肌酐和BUN升高。还观察到体重（BW）下降和肾重（KW）增加，且KW/BW比值升高。裂解的caspase-3和NF-κB表达也增加。组织病理学异常，如肾小体损伤、鲍曼囊间隙增宽、肾小球和系膜细胞崩解、足细胞萎缩、空泡化和纤维化改变也可见。LEV 0.1和FF 80显著逆转了这些变化至正常水平，显示出肾脏保护潜力。因此，鉴于LEV对CP中毒小鼠的保护作用，我们得出结论，LEV可能作为癌症治疗中CP的辅助药物，但需要更多直接癌症模型的进一步研究来证实这一主张。
